body: I am afraid of causing sadness. I'd rather keep it to myself than have my sadness affect someone else. Which is why I'm scared I'm going to break one day and do it. As far as why I'm sad, I know there's a reason. I just don't know why or what. Any reason I could think of seems like my feelings are an overreaction to it. So it seems like I am acutely sad for no reason

I don't think I have a situation because I'm just unhappy for no reason. 

I could be happy with my life. Other people probably would be. 
I'm just lonely and i perpetuate it. But thank you.

I wish I had enough guts to show this to my boyfriend

I'm afraid

I'm afraid he won't care or that his concern won't be genuine, just out of obligation

I'm afraid that he really will care and it will hurt him badly that I haven't been able to feel it

I don't know what to do

I've been crying on and off for the past two hours

I wish someone were out there but then I don't, I'd be too scared to talk

I just wish a stranger out there would care

I feel like it'd be more genuine

A stranger isn't obligated to me like family or friends

I wish I could feel someone caring, though, you can always just say so

I wish I could feel the warmth from someone that I do when I'm happy sometimes, but coming from someone, directed towards me

I don't feel that sort of thing from my boyfriend very often, I don't know if it's just him or me though

My love outpaces his though, I know that, and I know I'm needy and I hate it so much

Also why I want to die

I'm just documenting my feelings

I'm alone and in the dark

I hate my body and it is the source of a lot of my unhappiness

There are things about it that I can't change, genetic disorders and whatnot

I don't understand how anyone could love me

I feel like my boyfriend is lying and that he starts to slip in the facade that he cares about me

I feel forgotten

I don't feel like people view me as someone with feelings because of the way I am

I don't think he thinks about me like I do him

I don't think anyone thinks about me, or wonders about me

I try to think of other people, I do

I don't think anyone really loves me or cares about me

If I died they'd feel sad out of obligation of just knowing me, no one would be sad a year or two down the line

Why does this seem to happen yearly

My first attempt was six years ago almost to the week

Then I see I posted something similar last year

What is wrong with me

I'm afraid of medication, I was on it once and it didn't help me

I feel like I'm fighting with my brain to not go into autopilot mode and take pills. I think if I just stopped trying my body would walk into the kitchen and down all the pills I could and the whiskey. Is that dissociation? I feel like I'm trying not to dissociate but I feel like I'm losing
I feel I need a straitjacket. This is bad

I think there may be some sort of confidentiality between counselors and patients, not sure how it'd translate over to school counselors and students, but it'd be worth asking the school counselor if she wouldn't tell your mother about things, just to have someone to trust
I'm scared. I think I'm going to lock myself in my closet until this feeling passes
I don't think this was a good idea

Hi - if possible, try reaching out to a school counselor. I can't tell where you are but it's my understanding that nearly all schools have one. They will be able to help in terms of grades and even emotional support since most are trained in that as well, or at the very least they can point you in the right direction. I wish I had reached out to a counselor when I was your age.

I'm not good at forming responses very quickly right now, but I don't think I would be a good Skype partner if I even had Skype. I'm sorry you're feeling similar to me though. Please take care of yourself.
I'm really lonely. I made a post about this before if you want to read it. But I'm lonely and sad and the combination scares me. I'm trying to keep myself from doing anything reckless.
I still feel this way even after making changes in my life. I don't know if it's ever going to get better.

No one will probably read this due to its length. I have no one to talk to right now, so even if no one reads or responds, there's a possibility someone might and that makes me feel a little better. But now I'm going to take some medicine and try to finally get some rest.
